IC1: ED physicians who work casually (less than 0.25 Full Time Equivalent)
IC2: ED Physicians who are routinely using U/S guided RA for hip fracture patients, or decline participation in the trial.
IC4: Patients who are delirious [OR] on initial assessment by ED physician or severe dementia
IC5: Patients with communication problems (critically ill [OR], unconscious [OR], language barrier despite use of secure telephone-based translation service)
IC6: Patients with allergies [OR] to narcotics or local anesthetic; or anticoagulant use (e.g. warfarin [OR], dabigatran [OR], rivaroxaban).
IC7: Patients with hip fractures [NOT] not requiring surgery (e.g. greater trochanter avulsion) will also be excluded.
